decisions.reason: Its earlier signal of major market acceptance in a core marine cooling application makes this option look largely validated, and the value of retaining it in the portfolio is high relative to the likely cost of keeping it available.

This marine cooling unit is close to the firm's established capabilities and customer base, so with no clear failure signal management would keep the option open, though the lack of fresh visible evidence raises some chance of later withdrawal.

As a related finned-tube offering that complements the firm's air-cooler business, it is inexpensive to maintain as a portfolio option and still worth keeping unless clearer evidence emerges that demand is too weak.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes fit tightly with the firm's engineering and heat-transfer know-how, so a real-options logic favors continued offering while learning continues and unless stronger negative market evidence appears.
